description: Current prices for one product at every retailer ShopSavvy has an offer from, lowest price first: retailer, price, availability, condition, marketplace seller, when the offer was last checked, and a link; then any in-store shelf prices read from shoppers' receipts (store, address, receipt date; labeled user-collected, a price on that day, not current stock); followed by a source line naming ShopSavvy with the product page link (cite it when you quote prices). Online prices are in US dollars. Use product_offers_retailer for a single store and product_price_history for past prices; a barcode, ASIN or ShopSavvy ID gives the most reliable match. Free without an API key; 3 credits with a key, nothing when no offers or in-store prices are found. If no offers are returned, say no current prices were found; do not estimate a price.

identifier.description: Product identifier (barcode, ASIN, URL, model number, product name, or ShopSavvy ID)
